blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Add to Coffee, Smoothies, Recipes & More
paragraphs: A clean, single-ingredient supplement made with 10,000 mg of hydrolyzed fish collagen (whitefish) per scoop. This unflavored powder delivers 9 grams of protein with no sugar, additives, or aftertaste — just full-body support for skin, joints, and connective tissue. It blends seamlessly into coffee, tea, smoothies, and more

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Mix one scoop with 6-10 ounces of your favorite beverage or recipe. The most popular choices are coffee, smoothies, juices, tea, and foods such as yogurt or oatmeal. It is not recommended to mix with plain water.
Mix, shake, blend or get creative.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Manufactured in a facility which process milk, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, wheat, soybeans, and sesame.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: If you are pregnant, nursing, allergic, or have a medical condition, or are taking any medications, consult a doctor before using this or any other dietary supplement. Do not use if product has been opened or tampered with in any way. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool dry place.
Amount inside is measured by weight, not volume.
